spec.name: Starry Mill
spec.description: A Dutch smock windmill in Animal Crossing style: a chunky brick tower with a flower-boxed gallery ring, a cream battened smock, a dark red cap and four lattice-and-cloth sails frozen in an X, its windows glowing warm.
spec.layout: The mill stands centred on x=0, front facing +Z. From the ground up: a tapered round brick tower (radius 1.35 at y=0 to 1.15 at y=1.55) with an arched plank door and stone steps at the front, small glowing windows, and cream mortar/trim bands; a wooden gallery ring wrapping the tower at y 1.55-1.78 (deck overhanging to radius 1.6) with a railing, brackets and hanging flower boxes; a cream plaster smock tapering from radius 1.05 at y=1.78 to 0.62 at y=3.35 with dark wooden battens and small glowing windows; a dark red dome cap y 3.35-3.95 with a cream rim band, a finial ball on top and a tail pole angling down to the back. At the front of the cap, a wooden hub at mount capHub carries four sails as one rigid assembly on the sailAxle hinge, resting as an X (blades at 45, 135, 225, 315 degrees), each a wooden spar with cream lattice frame and white cloth panels, sweeping in the x-y plane at z about 0.6. Style: Animal Crossing toylike chunky proportions, every surface one flat colour, bold trim bands, dot-like flowers in pink and yellow on green foliage, warm glowing window panes, faceted low-poly curves. Only the base part and its stone steps touch the floor at y=0.

parts.builds: The brick ground tower of the mill, y 0 to 1.55, riding joint mill. Build the tower as a faceted low-poly taper (b.lathe or a swept frustum, ~16 sides): radius 1.35 at y=0, radius 1.25 at y=0.8, radius 1.15 at y=1.55, main colour brick. Seat small darker brick patches (tiny slightly-protruding slabs, colour brickDark) scattered over the surface, denser low down and near the door edges. Add three horizontal cream mortar/trim bands as thin protruding rings (colour trim) at y 0.45, 0.95 and a wider one at y 1.45 just under the top. Front face, facing +Z: an arched door recess centred at x=0, the arch of trim-coloured stones (small wedge slabs around the semicircular top), door leaf colour door with three vertical plank seams as thin dark slats, a small round cream knob, the door filling roughly x -0.32..0.32, y 0.02..0.95. Two stone steps (colour stone) in front of the door, stacked blocks whose lowest faces rest exactly on y=0, with the top step meeting the door sill. Flank the door with two small round-arch windows at x about +/-0.75, y about 1.1: dark windowFrame surround, glass pane, and a slightly inset warm glow pane colour glow so the light reads as lit from inside. The tower bottom edge and the steps are the only floor contact of the whole model: everything rests exactly on y=0.
parts.attaches: Stands alone on the floor; its top face at y=1.55 is mount baseTop, which the gallery deck sits on and the smock rises from behind.

parts.builds: The wooden balcony ring that wraps the tower at y 1.55 to 1.78, riding joint mill. Build a flat annular deck: inner radius 1.16 (hugging the tower), outer radius 1.6, thickness 0.14, made of wedge-shaped plank sectors (about 16 planks, alternating wood and a slightly lighter wood tone by mixing wood with trim for a subtle two-tone, separated by thin woodDark gaps). A bold rim band of woodDark runs around the outer edge top and bottom. Under the deck, 8 small wooden brackets (small angled boxes, woodDark) step inward to the tower wall. On the outer edge stands a railing: evenly spaced square posts (woodDark) around the full circle, joined by a continuous top rail (wood) and a mid rail, with tiny cream trim caps on each post top for the toy look. Hang flower boxes on the railing at 6 angles (skip the exact front centre where the door sightline is): each box a small wooden trough (wood, woodDark rim) filled with a low mound of leaf-coloured foliage blobs and 5-8 round flower dots, alternating flowerPink and flowerYellow. Add two small hanging lanterns at the front-left and front-right posts (tiny dark frame, glowing glow pane) for warmth.
parts.attaches: The deck's inner top edge rests on the tower at mount baseTop (tower top y=1.55); the deck top face at y=1.78 is mount deckTop, where the smock stands.

parts.builds: The cream upper tower and the cap, y 1.78 to 3.98, riding joint mill. Build the smock as a faceted taper (about 14 sides): radius 1.05 at y=1.78, 0.85 at y=2.55, 0.62 at y=3.35, colour plaster. Cover it with vertical wooden battens: about 20 thin strips (colour batten) running up the surface, following the taper, plus 4 slightly wider corner pilasters for rhythm. A cream trim band (colour trim) rings the bottom at y 1.78-1.92 meeting mount deckTop, and a second thin trim ring sits at y 3.25 just under the cap. Windows: two small square windows at the front (z+), x about +/-0.45, y about 2.4, dark windowFrame surround, glass pane with a warm glow pane behind it; one round porthole window at the front, x=0, y about 3.05, same treatment with a cream ring trim. The cap at mount capSeat y 3.35: a dome (b.lathe) from radius 0.68 at its rim, curving up to a rounded top at y 3.9, colour cap, with a cream trim band at its bottom rim and a small ball finial (trim) on a tiny stem at the apex. At the front of the cap, a round wooden hub drum (colour axle, with a metal-toned ring of axle and a small cream centre cap) protrudes to z=0.55, centred exactly on mount capHub [0, 3.62, 0.55]; the sail blades mount into this hub but the hub itself is built here. At the back, a tail pole: a long wooden pole (woodDark) from the cap's rear angling down and back to about [0, 3.0, -1.1], with three small cross rungs, the classic cap-turning tail.
parts.attaches: Its bottom trim band stands on the gallery deck at mount deckTop (y=1.78); its dome sits on the smock top at mount capSeat (y=3.35); its front hub is centred on mount capHub where the sail assembly meets it.

parts.builds: The four sail blades, one rigid assembly riding joint sailAxle, whose origin is mount capHub [0, 3.62, 0.55] with the axle pointing +Z out of the cap. Build the blades in the x-y plane at the axle: at rest the four blades sit at 45, 135, 225 and 315 degrees (an X). Each blade: a main wooden spar from radius 0.1 to 1.45 out from the hub (colour sailFrame, a shallow-tapered frustum box about 0.34 wide at the root narrowing to 0.24 at the tip, lying flat in the sail plane with a little thickness); 4 crossbars (sailFrame) spaced evenly along it at right angles to the spar; and between the crossbars, alternating white cloth panels (colour sailCloth, thin flat quads with slightly rounded corners, giving a puffy patchwork look) and open lattice gaps, so each blade reads as 3 cloth patches with cream framing. Add a small cream tip cap on each blade end and a tiny dot detail (sailFrame stud) at the outer end of each crossbar. Give every blade exactly the same construction, only rotated about the axle, so the assembly is perfectly symmetric; keep all geometry within z 0.42..0.72 so the blades sweep clear of the smock surface (which bows out to z about 0.8 at its widest) and of the cap dome.
parts.attaches: Roots into the hub at mount capHub, riding joint sailAxle so the whole assembly can spin; at rest the blades form an X in the x-y plane in front of the smock and cap.
